$doc: WP4 (order 2026-08-11 §8): phase-1 difficulty x phase-1 learning-rate 2x2 factorial. The prior L1 factorial varied PHASE-2 LR with phase-1 LR fixed at 1e-4, so it cannot say whether phase-1 LR caused the collapse. This design crosses phase-1 dynamics {normal, easy} with phase-1 LR {1e-4, 3e-5}; phase-2 stays at the active D0 range point. Mechanics screen first (one pass-equivalent per cell, collapse/contract screen, not performance); the decision run spends the full document-38 budget only if the screen finds a viable region.
question: Was the apparent easy/normal difficulty question actually a phase-1 learning-rate problem?

held_fixed.$doc: Order §8: every non-factor identity field is pinned. Replay and optimizer carry are excluded as factors this round — every ladder arm already proved optimizer_state_transferred=false and replay_size_at_boundary=0 at the boundary (audit §3).
held_fixed.handoff_viability_evidence: required on every phase-1 checkpoint (WP3 / finding 221 block)
held_fixed.topology_features_costs_protection: L1 v3 frozen system manifest contract (sha 00bfa585 family) — spread 1e-4, protected entries required, min_equity 100, financing declared-disabled
held_fixed.dates: ladder/L1 nested split contract; sealed 2025 inaccessible
held_fixed.selection: normal-realistic paired comparator on train-monitor + inner validation; outer validation truth
held_fixed.anchor_rule: every cell starts from the exact per-seed anchor, never a preceding cell's terminal

assignments.$doc: One seed per physical GPU; ALL FOUR cells of a seed run sequentially on that same GPU so hardware is paired within seed. Distributed anchors hash-verified on their hosts 2026-08-11.

cell_order.$doc: Deterministic cyclic Latin square: every cell occupies every within-seed position exactly once across seeds — no order/thermal confounding.

mechanics_screen.budget: one pass-equivalent per cell (1 phase-1 epoch + 1 phase-2 epoch at 20000 timesteps, matching the ladder pass budget)

budget_knobs.$doc: Executable form of the budget line above (runner WP4; the prose stays authoritative for intent). The runner refuses any values other than one pass-equivalent, and refuses an epoch_timesteps that does not match the ladder pass budget.

requires: 16/16 records with exact identities and terminal artifacts (terminal_model_path + terminal_model_sha256 mandatory — finding 223 contract)
all four terminal loads proven on the replica host for each completed seed batch
direct handoff-viability facts on every phase-1 checkpoint (finding 221 block)
at least one trained arm not CONSTANT_POLICY and not BELOW_NORMAL_THRESHOLD before the decision budget is spent
mechanics_screen.collapse_outcome: PHASE1_LR_REGION_COLLAPSED — stop, do not burn the full run

decision_run.$doc: Only if the screen finds a viable region. Document-38 real L1 stopping.

forbidden: broad LR sweep (LR_easy x LR_normal response surface requires a viable easy arm from THIS factorial first)
reusing any L1 decision or ladder identity
citing the ladder as a pure boundary effect — accepted wording is the v3-vs-v4 checkpoint-selection/handoff bundle with easy-phase action-amplitude collapse exposed by the normal deadband
